input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel. Vendor will execute further documents reasonably needed to confirm ownership.
input.rationale: The IP provisions meet our preferred position. Section 14.1 confirms we own Customer Data, our confidential information and our independently developed IP, with only a limited processing right to Vendor; Section 14.2 vests each Deliverable in us with an express Vendor assignment (and personnel assignments plus further-assurance); Section 14.3 leaves Vendor Technology with Vendor but pulls in the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence (including modify and create derivative works) for embedded Vendor Technology, with an obligation to flag restrictive third-party material. Section 14.4 excludes joint ownership absent a signed instrument identifying exploitation rights, and keeps feedback voluntary with our own use rights preserved. The definitions support this: "Customer Data" includes derived output and excludes only anonymized, non-linkable telemetry, and "Vendor Technology" expressly excludes Customer Data and our pre-existing IP. Section 15.1 further bars sale, advertising use, cross-customer combination and model training on Customer Data without our consent. No assignment of our IP or data to Vendor and no aggregate/derived-data ownership grab appears anywhere in the document, so no redline is needed.
